instruction: Can you configure VLC to always continue playback from where I left off? I often pause videos and want to resume them later without being asked.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's continue playback setting (qt-continue=1). Created custom metric function check_qt_continue_playback__e7d03ebf to verify the vlcrc configuration file has the correct setting.
